facts.fact: 周四差五分午夜，Meg 发出辞职信——特意抄送 Cameron。
facts.anchor: At five minutes to midnight Thursday night, I quit tinkering with my resignation letter and hit send.

facts.fact: 辞职信以「一个不相关的机会」为由二月底走人，附约三周通知（含两周在休假期）。
facts.anchor: referenced “an unrelated opportunity that necessitates my leaving by the end of February.”

facts.fact: 清晨六点起消息涌入，她开了免打扰，只扫一眼未读数就去洗澡。
facts.anchor: Starting at six a.m.—nine Eastern time—texts and emails began flooding in, but I had set my phone to Do Not Disturb.

facts.fact: 母亲传话 Peterson 先生来电，还担心女儿惹了麻烦。
facts.anchor: “Mr. Peterson wants you to call,” Mom called up the stairs when I came out of the bathroom in a towel.

facts.fact: 四十岁女人失去全部 fucks——她原以为只指性，此刻懂了：是优先级与谁配得到注意力。
facts.anchor: I’d been told women lost all their fucks at forty. I’d honestly believed that was a reference to sex, but in this moment, I understood it was broader than that.

facts.fact: 她伸手摸那罐 fucks，罐是空的——根本没有罐子；只觉得无畏、轻盈。
facts.anchor: I reached for my jar of fucks and found it empty. In fact, there was no jar.

facts.fact: 她给 HR 报出昂贵的合同时薪，毫无愧疚。
facts.anchor: then told HR what my hourly rate would be if they wanted to hire me on contract. It was an exorbitant amount, and I felt no guilt or shame.

facts.fact: 章末她端咖啡出门「踏上新生活」，天却下起雪。
